chk_task_artifacts_variant.name: chk_task_artifacts_variant
chk_task_artifacts_variant.value:
("classification" = 'workflow'
        and length(trim("code")) > 0
        and "artifact_id" = 'workflow:' || "task_id" || ':' || "code"
        and "markdown" is not null
        and "format" is not null
        and ("verdict" is null or length(trim("verdict")) > 0)
        and "content" is null and "file_name" is null
        and "media_type" is null and "byte_size" is null)
      or ("classification" = 'free'
        and length("code") between 1 and 128
        and "code" glob '[a-z]*' and "code" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
        and instr("code", '--') = 0 and substr("code", -1) <> '-'
        and "artifact_id" not like 'workflow:%'
        and "markdown" is null
        and "format" is null and "verdict" is null
        and "source_tool" is null and "updated_by" is null
        and "updated_at_ms" is not null and "revision" >= 1
        and typeof("content") = 'blob'
        and "file_name" is not null and "media_type" is not null
        and "byte_size" is not null and "byte_size" between 0 and 10485760
        and length("content") = "byte_size")

chk_task_sessions_model.name: chk_task_sessions_model
chk_task_sessions_model.value: ("model_runtime_kind" is null and "model_provider_id" is null and "model_id" is null and "model_variant" is null and "model_profile_id" is null and "model_speed" is null) or ("model_runtime_kind" is not null and "model_provider_id" is not null and "model_id" is not null)

chk_workspace_sessions_execution.name: chk_workspace_sessions_execution
chk_workspace_sessions_execution.value: ("execution_kind" = 'local_repo_root' and "branch_name" is null and "worktree_state" is null) or ("execution_kind" = 'local_worktree' and "worktree_state" in ('present', 'removed'))

chk_workspace_sessions_role.name: chk_workspace_sessions_role
chk_workspace_sessions_role.value: ("role_snapshot_id" is null and "role_snapshot_name" is null and "role_snapshot_system_prompt" is null) or ("role_snapshot_id" is not null and "role_snapshot_name" is not null and "role_snapshot_system_prompt" is not null)

chk_workspace_sessions_model.name: chk_workspace_sessions_model
chk_workspace_sessions_model.value: ("model_runtime_kind" is null and "model_provider_id" is null and "model_id" is null and "model_variant" is null and "model_profile_id" is null and "model_speed" is null) or ("model_runtime_kind" = "runtime_kind" and "model_provider_id" is not null and "model_id" is not null)

chk_workspace_azure_config_identity.name: chk_workspace_azure_config_identity
chk_workspace_azure_config_identity.value:
("deployment" is null and "service_url" is null and "organization" is null
        and "project" is null and "repository_name" is null)
        or ("deployment" is not null and "service_url" is not null
          and "organization" is not null and "project" is not null
          and "repository_name" is not null)

chk_workspace_azure_config_nonempty.name: chk_workspace_azure_config_nonempty
chk_workspace_azure_config_nonempty.value:
"repository_name" is not null or "http_consent_collection_url" is not null
        or "area_path" is not null

chk_agent_runtime_settings_policy.name: chk_agent_runtime_settings_policy
chk_agent_runtime_settings_policy.value:
"policy_json" is null or (json_valid("policy_json")
        and json_type("policy_json") is 'object'
        and json_type("policy_json", '$.defaults') is 'object'
        and json_type("policy_json", '$.roleOverrides') is 'object')
